title: Implement main pipeline orchestrator (pipeline.ts)
description: Implement src/lib/pipeline.ts which orchestrates all 6 pipeline stages for a single prospect: data gathering → condensation → structure decision → content generation → image sourcing → variant assignment + color theming. Updates prospect status at each stage via the repository.
acceptanceCriteria: Updates prospect status at each pipeline stage
Handles errors gracefully — sets status to 'failed' with error details on any failure
Saves intermediate results to the database at each stage
Returns the completed SiteConfig on success
Full pipeline runs end-to-end for a test prospect

steps.description: Create src/lib/pipeline.ts with the orchestration function
steps.details: Import all pipeline stage functions and repository functions. Define `async function runPipeline(prospectId: string): Promise<SiteConfig>`.

Load prospect from repository. If `existing_url` is set: call `crawlUrl(existing_url)`, save `scraped_raw` and `scraped_branding` to DB. Update status to 'analyzing'. If no URL: skip scraping, proceed with prospect fields only.
Call `extractBusinessData(crawlResult, prospect)`. If token estimate >= 4000: call `condenseBusinessData(...)`. Save `extracted_data` and `condensed_profile` to DB. Update status to 'generating'.
Call `generateStructure(profile, prospect)`. Save `structure` to DB. Call `generateContent(structure, profile, prospect)`. Save `site_content` to DB.

Update status to 'sourcing_images'. Call `assignImages(sections, prospect, batchId)` (from TASK-53). Update status to 'assembling'. Call `assignVariants(sections, prospect.businessName, prospect.industry)`. Call `selectPalette(branding, structure.paletteHint)`. Build final `SiteConfig`. Save `site_config` to DB. Update status to 'ready'.

Wrap the entire function in try/catch. On error: call `updateProspectStatus(prospectId, 'failed')` and store the error message in the prospect notes or a dedicated error field. Re-throw so the API route can return a 500.

Call `runPipeline` with a test prospect ID for a real roofing business with a website. Monitor the console and database to verify status progresses through all stages and `site_config` is saved with complete data.

technicalNotes: The pipeline is called from the Next.js API route (TASK-70) which returns immediately after starting the pipeline. Status updates are polled by the UI.
Consider running the pipeline in a background promise (`runPipeline(id).catch(...)`) so the API route can return 202 Accepted immediately.
Each DB save of intermediate data allows resuming or debugging if something fails partway through.
Total cost per full pipeline run: ~$0.013-0.018 (Anthropic only).
